import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.iterators import FrameIterator

# Get the existing videos table
videos_table = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a frame iterator that samples at 1 fps
frame_iterator = FrameIterator.create(video=videos_table.video, fps=1)

# Create a one-to-many view that expands each video into frame rows
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    'video_frames',
    videos_table,
    iterator=frame_iterator,
    if_exists='replace'
)

# Display the schema of the new view
print(f"Created view: {frames_view.get_schema()}")

import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.iterators import FrameIterator

# Get the existing videos table
videos_table = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a frame iterator that samples at 1 fps
frame_iterator = FrameIterator.create(video=videos_table.video, fps=1)

# Create a one-to-many view that expands each video into frame rows
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    'video_frames',
    videos_table,
    iterator=frame_iterator,
    if_exists='replace'
)

# Display the schema of the new view
print(f"Created view: {frames_view.get_schema()}")
